question: Which sector recorded the highest number of refund-related grievances in July 2025, according to the National Consumer Helpline (NCH)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**E-commerce**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The e-commerce sector recorded the highest number of refund-related grievances, with 3,594 cases in July 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• E-commerce recorded 3,594 refund-related grievances in July 2025, leading to Rs 1.34 crore in refunds.
 
• Overall, NCH facilitated refunds totaling Rs 2.72 crore, addressing grievances across 27 sectors.
 
• In addition to e-commerce, the Travel & Tourism sector also contributed to refunds, totaling Rs 31 lakh.
 
• The technological transformation of NCH significantly improved its efficiency, resulting in a large increase in complaint registrations and call volumes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• National Consumer Helpline (NCH)__

 __
 
• NCH acts as a unified platform for grievance redressal, connecting consumers, government agencies, and regulatory bodies.
 
• Consumer grievance registration via digital channels, such as WhatsApp, has seen significant growth in recent years.
 
 
 
• Technological Enhancements__
 
 
• The integration of WhatsApp with NCH’s toll-free number (1915) has improved grievance registration efficiency during high call volumes.
 
• A dedicated feedback mechanism was introduced to continuously improve the helpline's services.
